# Plan: Nemotron-H Hybrid Inference on 12GB CUDA GPU

## 1. Technical Analysis & Tensor Offloading Strategy

### 1.1 Architecture Constraints (from `src/models/nemotron-h.cpp`)
The Nemotron-H model uses a **Hybrid/MoE architecture** with three critical tensor categories that must be managed for 12GB GPU memory:

| Tensor Category | Exact Names (per layer `i`) | Memory Impact | Offloading Requirement |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Mamba SSM** | `ssm_in`, `ssm_conv1d`, `ssm_conv1d_b`, `ssm_dt_b`, `ssm_a`, `ssm_d`, `ssm_norm`, `ssm_out` | High (8 tensors/layer, ~2-5GB total) | **Must stay on GPU** for latency; `ssm_conv1d` is the largest single tensor |
| **Attention** | `attn_norm`, QKV weights (`create_tensor_qkv` output `wo`), `wo_b` | Medium (~1-2GB) | **Must stay on GPU** |
| **Shared-Experts (MoE)** | `ffn_down_shexp`, `ffn_up_shexp` | Medium (~500MB-1.5GB) | **Overflow to CPU** — these are the "shared" experts that don't participate in routing-based expert selection |
| **Routed Experts** | `ffn_down_exps`, `ffn_up_exps`, `ffn_gate_inp`, `ffn_exp_probs_b` | High (conditional on `n_expert`) | **Overflow to CPU** — only activated when routing selects them |
| **NextN/MTP Draft Heads** | `nextn.enorm`, `nextn.hnorm`, `nextn.eh_proj`, `shared_head_norm`, `attn_norm`, QKV, `wo`, `wo_b`, `ffn_gate_inp`, `ffn_down_exps`, `ffn_up_exps`, `ffn_down_shexp`, `ffn_up_shexp` | Medium | **Stay on GPU** for MTP draft acceleration |
